title: Small But Mighty: How to Use Apps to Improve Your Marketing

facts.fact: Agorapulse, a social media management tool recommended in this sponsored Mailchimp article, has pricing that starts at $79 per month, per the page.
Later, a scheduling app for Instagram posts, has a free version for individuals and a $19-per-month plan for small businesses, according to the page.
facts.quote: Later has a free version for individuals and a $19-per-month plan for small businesses.

facts.fact: Buffer, a multi-platform social management tool, costs between $16 and $99 per month for small businesses, according to the page.
facts.quote: Costs range from $16-$99 per month for small businesses.

facts.fact: Word Swag and Canva are both free to use, with additional features available for purchase, according to the page.
facts.quote: Both apps are free to use and offer additional features for purchase.

facts.fact: According to the page, 45% of Stringjoy customers become repeat shoppers, a figure attributed to the company rather than independently verified.
facts.quote: Forty-five percent of Stringjoy customers become repeat shoppers.

facts.fact: The article is dated May 23, 2019, and is labeled as paid content produced by Inc. Custom Studio for Mailchimp.
